## Summary
Establish a process and template for documenting architectural decisions.

## Context
No ADR process exists. All major decisions must be tracked for governance and traceability.

## Tasks
- [ ] Create ADR template in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] Document initial ADRs for key decisions
- [ ] Update contribution guide to require ADRs

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ADR template available
- [ ] Initial ADRs documented
- [ ] Contribution guide updated

## Impact
Untracked architectural changes can cause confusion and technical debt.

## References
Blocks all design and implementation issues.

## Additional Notes
Require ADR for all breaking changes.
